title: Measuring the Payment Record for a Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing Hardship Deferral
content:
*Servicing analytics note.*

For a hardship deferral on a Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing account whose plan carries no promotion (a fixed-rate or low-payment plan), what the payment record counts follows how the borrower has been paying: an account that made an extra-principal payment within the span its record is read over counts whole scheduled payments' worth of money, the scheduled-payment and extra-principal amounts posted in that span less the amounts returned unpaid in it, divided by the scheduled monthly payment and rounded down; an account with no such payment that is enrolled in autopay counts its autopay draws in that span less the payments returned unpaid in it; every other account counts its scheduled-payment entries in that span less the payments returned unpaid in it.

Each scheduled monthly payment is the plan's payment factor per 1,000.00 times the financed amount, rounded to the cent, and never under the plan's minimum monthly payment. Every amount rounded to the cent goes to the nearest cent, and an exact half cent rounds up.

## Count by paying pattern

| Extra-principal payment posted in the span | Enrolled in autopay | Payment record |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Either | Scheduled-payment and extra-principal money posted in the span, less money returned unpaid in it, divided by the scheduled monthly payment, rounded down |
| No | Yes | Number of autopay draws in the span, less the number of payments returned unpaid in it |
| No | No | Number of scheduled-payment entries in the span, less the number of payments returned unpaid in it |

## Hypothetical illustrations

- Scheduled monthly payment 200.00; in the span, scheduled payments of 2000.00, one extra-principal payment of 700.00 and one returned payment of 200.00: 2500.00 divided by 200.00 is 12.5, rounded down to 12.
- No extra-principal payment, autopay enrolled, 11 autopay draws and 1 returned payment in the span: 10.
- No extra-principal payment, not enrolled in autopay, 9 scheduled-payment entries and no returns in the span: 9.
